programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u055/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-17c9e74a.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    line = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row))
    bg = grid[0][0]
    object_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) for v in row if v != bg and v != 2]
    height = max(object_rows) - min(object_rows) + 1
    side = -1 if max(object_rows) < line else 1
    target = line + side * (height + 1)
    out[target] = [8] * len(grid[0])
    return out
'''
